20370-rhymes-of-the-east-and-re-collecte.creator: Unknown
20370-rhymes-of-the-east-and-re-collecte.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. For Knowledge to their ears her ample store,  Rich with the latest news, does then impart,  Whose source, when known, shall chill you to the core,  And freeze the genial cockles of the heart.

23819-la-chanson-de-roland-translated-fr.title: Professor at the Ecole des Chartes, Paris.
23819-la-chanson-de-roland-translated-fr.creator: Henry Holt & Co.
23819-la-chanson-de-roland-translated-fr.description: A book by Henry Holt & Co.. On the 15th of August, 778, in a little Pyrenean Valley, still known in our days by the name of Ronceval, a terrible event took place. Charlemagne, returning from his expedition to Spain, crossed that valley and the Pyrenees, leaving his rear-guard in command of Roland, Prefect of the Marches of Brittany.

arxiv-2201-11375.title: On sections of arithmetic fundamental groups of open p p -adic annuli.
arxiv-2201-11375.creator: Mohamed Saïdi
arxiv-2201-11375.description: Abstract We show the non-existence of sections of arithmetic fundamental groups of open p p -adic annuli of small radii , this implies the non-existence of sections of arithmetic fundamental groups of formal boundaries of formal germs of p p -adic curves . §0.

arxiv-2201-13247.title: The Sturdiness of the Shell Model: Informal Review
arxiv-2201-13247.creator: Castaly Fan, Larry Zamick
arxiv-2201-13247.description: Abstract With shell model codes being able to encompassing larger and larger spaces we find that the percentage occupancy of the leading spaces becomes smaller and smaller. How can the shell model survive in such circumstances? We will not solve this puzzle here but rather will show examples where, with some explanations, the shell model holds fast.

arxiv-2302-02557.title: Fast Direct Localization for Millimeter Wave MIMO Systems via Deep ADMM Unfolding Thanks: This work was supported in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grant Nos. U1936201 and 62001103. ( Corresponding authors: Yongming Huang and Shengheng Liu ) Thanks: The authors are wi
arxiv-2302-02557.creator: Wenzhe Fan, Graduate Student Member, IEEE, Shengheng Liu, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2302-02557.description: Abstract Massive arrays deployed in millimeter-wave systems enable high angular resolution performance, which in turn facilitates sub-meter localization services. Albeit suboptimal, up to now the most popular localization approach has been based on a so-called two-step procedure, where triangulation is applied upon aggregation of the angle-of-arrival (AoA) measurements from the collaborative base stations.

arxiv-2311-07918.title: Automated title and abstract screening for scoping reviews using the GPT-4 Large Language Model
arxiv-2311-07918.creator: David Wilkins
arxiv-2311-07918.description: Abstract Scoping reviews, a type of systematic literature review, require intensive human effort to screen large numbers of scholarly sources for their relevance to the review objectives. This manuscript introduces GPTscreenR, a package for the R statistical programming language that uses the GPT-4 Large Language Model (LLM) to automatically screen sources.

arxiv-2410-07350.title: Gravitational Waves from the Hagedorn Phase
arxiv-2410-07350.creator: Gonzalo Villa
arxiv-2410-07350.description: Abstract We illustrate the main points behind the computation of the gravitational wave spectrum originated from a phase in the early universe where the energy density is dominated by highly excited fundamental string degrees of freedom - a Hagedorn phase.

arxiv-2412-13047.title: Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Satellite Image Photogrammetry
arxiv-2412-13047.creator: Luca Savant Aira, Gabriele Facciolo, Thibaud Ehret https://mezzelfo.github.io/EOGS/
arxiv-2412-13047.description: Abstract Recently, Gaussian splatting has emerged as a strong alternative to NeRF, demonstrating impressive 3D modeling capabilities while requiring only a fraction of the training and rendering time. In this paper, we show how the standard Gaussian splatting framework can be adapted for remote sensing, retaining its high efficiency.

arxiv-2505-11268.title: Dark standard siren cosmology with bright galaxy subsets
arxiv-2505-11268.creator: Khuzaifa Naveed, Cezary Turski, Archisman Ghosh
arxiv-2505-11268.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Khuzaifa Naveed, Cezary Turski, Archisman Ghosh. In this short paper, we investigate the impact of selecting only a subset of bright galaxies to provide redshift information for a dark standard siren measurement of the Hubble constant H 0 H_{0} .

arxiv-2601-11421.title: The Great March 100: 100 Detail-oriented Tasks for Evaluating Embodied AI Agents
arxiv-2601-11421.creator: Ziyu Wang, Chenyuan Liu, Yushun Xiang, Runhao Zhang, Yu Zhang, Qingbo Hao, Hongliang Lu, Houyu Chen, Zhizhong Feng, Kaiyue Zheng, Dehao Ye, Xianchao Zeng, Xinyu Zhou, Boran Wen, Jiaxin Li, Mingyu Zhang, Kecheng Zheng, Qian Zhu, Ran Cheng, Yong-Lu Li
arxiv-2601-11421.description: Abstract Recently, with the rapid development of robot learning and imitation learning, numerous datasets and methods have emerged. However, these datasets and their task designs often lack systematic consideration and principles. This raises important questions: Do the current datasets and task designs truly advance the capabilities of robotic agents?

arxiv-2602-12148.title: Resonating group method for baryon-baryon interactions with unequal oscillator frequencies and its application to the N ​ Δ N\Delta system in a chiral quark model
arxiv-2602-12148.creator: Ke-Rang Song, Fei Huang
arxiv-2602-12148.description: Abstract The resonating group method (RGM) is widely used to investigate baryon-baryon interactions at the quark level, typically under the assumption that the two baryons involved share an identical harmonic-oscillator frequency. In reality, however, when a specific interaction Hamiltonian is given, different baryons should have unequal oscillator frequencies due to distinct interaction potentials induced by their different quantum numbers.

arxiv-2602-20361.title: Learning During Detection: Continual Learning for Neural OFDM Receivers via DMRS
arxiv-2602-20361.creator: Mohanad Obeed, Member, IEEE, Ming Jian, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2602-20361.description: Abstract Deep neural networks (DNNs) have been increasingly explored for receiver design because they can handle complex environments without relying on explicit channel models. Nevertheless, because communication channels change rapidly, their distributions can shift over time, often making periodic retraining necessary.

pmc-10773571.title: Enterococcus species: insights into antimicrobial resistance and whole-genome features of isolates recovered from livestock and raw meat in Ghana
pmc-10773571.creator: Grebstad Rabbi Amuasi, Esther Dsani, Christian Owusu-Nyantakyi, Felicia A. Owusu, Quaneeta Mohktar, Pernille Nilsson, Bright Adu, Rene S. Hendriksen, Beverly Egyir
pmc-10773571.description: IntroductionEnterococcus spp. have gradually evolved from commensals to causing life-threatening hospital-acquired infections globally due to their inherent antimicrobial resistance ability and virulence potential. Enterococcus spp. recovered from livestock and raw meat samples were characterized using antimicrobial susceptibility testing and whole-genome sequencing.

pmc-11356759.title: Prevalence of Antimicrobial Resistance in Klebsiella pneumoniae, Enterobacter cloacae, and Escherichia coli Isolates among Stillbirths and Deceased Under-Five Children in Sierra Leone: Data from the Child Health and Mortality Prevention Surveillance Sites from 2019 to 2022
pmc-11356759.creator: Julius Ojulong, Gebrekrstos N. Gebru, Babatunde Duduyemi, Edwin Gbenda, Mohamed L. Janneh, Jack Sharty, Leonel Monteiro, Dickens Kowuor, Soter Ameh, Ikechukwu U. Ogbuanu
pmc-11356759.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Klebsiella pneumoniae, Escherichia coli, and Enterobacter cloacae are associated with most nosocomial infections worldwide. Although gaps remain in the knowledge of their susceptibility patterns, these are in antimicrobial stewardship. This study aimed to describe antimicrobial susceptibility profiles of the above organisms isolated from postmortem blood from stillbirths and under-five children enrolled in the Child Health and Mortality Prevention Surveillance (CHAMPS) program in Sierra Leone.

pmc-11525496.title: Polyurethane Waste Recycling: Thermolysis of the Carbamate Fraction
pmc-11525496.creator: Marthe Nees, Muhammad Adeel, Lukasz Pazdur, Matthew Porters, Christophe ML Vande Velde, Pieter Billen
pmc-11525496.description: The alcoholysis of polyurethane waste is currently being industrialized, making it one of the most advanced chemical recycling processes for polyurethanes. However, the recycling potential of the dicarbamate phase, which accounts for 10–40% of the polyurethane mass, is often disregarded, as mainly the polyol components are (partially) retrieved in many alcoholysis processes.

pmc-11532553.title: Development and validation of VTE prevention beliefs questionnaire for neurosurgical hospitalized patients based on HBM: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11532553.creator: Pan Lin
pmc-11532553.description: Patients hospitalized for neurosurgical procedures are highly susceptible to venous thromboembolism (VTE). It is crucial to evaluate the prevention beliefs of VTE among neurosurgical inpatients and analyse the influencing factors. This research sought to create an instrument grounded in the Health Belief Model (HBM) to evaluate the beliefs about VTE prevention and the factors influencing these beliefs among neurosurgical inpatients.

pmc-11644438.title: Hybrid Alumina–Silica Filler for Thermally Conductive Epoxidized Natural Rubber
pmc-11644438.creator: Hassarutai Yangthong, Phattarawadee Nun-Anan, Apinya Krainoi, Boonphop Chaisrikhwun, Seppo Karrila, Suphatchakorn Limhengha, Md Najib Alam, Vineet Kumar
pmc-11644438.description: Thermally conductive composites were prepared based on epoxidized natural rubber (ENR) filled with alumina, silica, and hybrid alumina and silica. The thermal conductivity and mechanical properties were assessed. It was observed that the interactions of polar functional groups in the fillers and epoxy group in ENR supported a fine dispersion of filler in the ENR matrix.

pmc-12433114.title: ST6GALNAC1 mediates sialylation of mucins in non-small cell lung cancer to evade immune surveillance
pmc-12433114.creator: Ting Fu, Yanan Wang, Ling Wang, Yanqing Mao
pmc-12433114.description: BackgroundNon-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) ranks first among common cancers worldwide and first among causes of cancer death. This study explored the function of ST6 N-acetylgalactosaminide alpha-2,6-sialyltransferase 1 (ST6GALNAC1) on immune surveillance in NSCLC.MethodsAll the samples (patients with NSCLCs) were immediately snap frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at −80 ℃ for further using.

pmc-12550932.title: Comparison and Analysis of Body Composition of MMA Fighters and Powerlifting Athletes
pmc-12550932.creator: Jarosław Muracki, Kacper Olszewski, Arkadiusz Stanula, Ahmet Kurtoğlu, Gabriel Stănică Lupu, Michał Nowak
pmc-12550932.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Mixed martial arts (MMA) is becoming increasingly popular and is developing dynamically in terms of training methods and number of participants involved, while weightlifting, powerlifting, and other kinds of strength disciplines are well established. In this study, the aim was to compare the body composition, as an anthropometric effect of training in MMA fighters and strength athletes, and then analyze and find reasoning for observed differences.

pmc-12736097.title: Baihe Dihuang Tang Exerts Antidepressant Effects via Modulation of MAOA-Mediated Serotonin Metabolism and Synaptic Plasticity
pmc-12736097.creator: Defu Tie, Yuting Wang, Jieru Zhou, Yiting Zhang, Hua Ji, Yue Yu, Haijun Han, Zheng Xiang, Wenlong Li, Marco Scarselli
pmc-12736097.description: Background/Objectives: Baihe Dihuang Tang (BDT), a classical herbal formula from Zhang Zhongjing’s Han Dynasty work Jin Gui Yao Lue, is widely used to treat depressive disorder by nourishing Yin, clearing heat, and tonifying the heart and lungs. However, its pharmacological mechanisms remain unclear.

pmc-13144778.title: Ursodeoxycholic Acid in the Management of Prolonged Neonatal Hyperbilirubinemia: A Randomized Controlled Clinical Trial
pmc-13144778.creator: Manijeh Tabrizi, Sadroddin Mahdipour, Seyyedeh Azade Hoseini Nouri, Vahid Aminzadeh, Zahra Ghadiri, Maryam Shahrokhi
pmc-13144778.description: Background: Prolonged indirect hyperbilirubinemia (PIH) is defined as bilirubin levels >10 mg/dL for more than 14 days in term infants and 21 days in preterm infants. Although the role of ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) as an adjunct to phototherapy has been evaluated, evidence in PIH remains limited. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate the effects of UDCA on PIH.

pmc-13214419.title: Gender-based analysis of visual and refractive characteristics in exotropia
pmc-13214419.creator: Masoud Khorrami-Nejad, Mohammad Reza Akbari, Babak Masoomian, Arash Mirmohammadsadeghi, Haider Resan Hussein, Foroozan Narooie-Noori
pmc-13214419.description: PurposeTo analyze gender-based differences in visual acuity, refractive error, angle of deviation, and amblyopia in patients with alternate exotropia (Alt XT) and intermittent exotropia (IXT).MethodA retrospective study of 4,417 surgical exotropia patients (2,970 Alt XT; 1,447 IXT) compared sex-based differences in CDVA, refraction, deviation angles, and amblyopia within each subtype.

pmc-13669976.title: Hearing Preservation Rates After Cochlear Implantation Using Soft Surgery Techniques
pmc-13669976.creator: Tina C Huang, Scott Lunos
pmc-13669976.description: ObjectivesTo determine if hearing preservation rates after cochlear implantation varied over time with soft surgery techniques.MethodsThe hearing preservation rate over time in adult cochlear implant patients over 10 years was analyzed. The association between hearing preservation rate and sex, age, perioperative steroid dose, and type of electrode was analyzed. Low frequency hearing preservation was analyzed separately.

pmc-3887317.title: The growing use of herbal medicines: issues relating to adverse reactions and challenges in monitoring safety
pmc-3887317.creator: Ekor M.
pmc-3887317.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). The use of herbal medicinal products and supplements has increased tremendously over the past three decades with not less than 80% of people worldwide relying on them for some part of primary healthcare.
